interpretation: L1–L7 are product capability boundaries, not mandatory deployment units or proof of AGI. Layers on a shared enabler mean applicability, not implemented ML functionality.
orderMeaning: A prerequisite-compatible planning order, not dates, an assignment, a queue reorder or permission to bypass phase/shared release gates. Work can be prepared while blockers are open. Later capabilities retain separate approval.

layers.name: Perception & Input
layers.input: Permitted text or explicitly released modality with independent input/interface/source/output locale and pinned source
layers.output: Structured concept/intent/language hypotheses or clarification/unavailable; no authoritative age, role or grade inference
layers.current: Disconnected query rewrite/intent/metadata candidates; no accepted VATS perception adapter or released ASR/OCR benchmark
layers.exit: Schema/ambiguity tests, permitted source mapping, multilingual/code-switch/handwriting or voice evaluation only for released modalities; bound bytes/deadline/cost, no silent fallback

layers.name: Student Cognition Model
layers.owner: Backend evidence authority; ML consumes scoped projections
layers.input: Immutable assessed receipts, approved concept DAG and source/criteria/model versions
layers.output: Knowledge estimate and evidence provenance, qualified mastery projection, prerequisite hypotheses with unknown state retained
layers.current: Pure BKT policy and ML prerequisite proposal only; durable SQL, validated error classifier, calibration and live learner state are missing
layers.exit: Atomic receipt/dedup/projection/outbox, replay/rebuild/calibration, source criteria scope and two-device acceptance; prior/model confidence/Build completion cannot establish mastery

layers.name: Adaptive Teaching Engine
layers.owner: ML proposal policy; backend deterministic loop/commit
layers.input: Current learner/loop revisions, prerequisite snapshot, approved pedagogy/visual set and reviewed error hypothesis
layers.output: Scoped teach/assess-prior/await/check-complete/review proposal; never a receipt, mastery grant or automatic notification
layers.current: Deterministic uncalibrated reference strategy/prerequisite policy, pure bounded loop and server binding; not registered with a controller/worker/frontend
layers.exit: Different remediation, at most three failed checks, assessed checks, stale proposal rejection, actual authorized durable flow and independently measured educational outcomes

layers.name: Model Stack & Grounding
layers.owner: ML evaluated adapters behind backend authority
layers.input: Pinned permitted context/prompt/model/tool policy with bounded usage and required sources
layers.output: Validated candidate or truthful unavailable/blocked/partial result; same policy across batch/stream/cache
layers.current: Disconnected RAG/retrieval/inference candidates; local NLI client and metric repairs do not qualify full gateway callers/stream/cache/source isolation
layers.exit: Actual provider/corpus held-out comparisons, source-authorized retrieval, citations/formulas/safety checks, invalid/timeout rejection, cancellation, usage settlement and rollback; NLI is not truth

layers.name: 3D Concept Visualization
layers.owner: Frontend rendering; backend manifest admission; ML representation proposal
layers.input: Approved concept/source/asset/scene versions, bounded typed parameters and device/accessibility preferences
layers.output: Authorized representation or accessible text/2D fallback, with scoped sequence/revision recovery
layers.current: Existing frontend representations/previews; no accepted end-to-end ML scene registry/event protocol or measured full 3D coverage
layers.exit: Published template/asset allowlist, parameter validation, synchronization/reconnect and real device/fallback tests; raw SCENE tokens/code/URLs never execute

layers.name: Memory & Personalization
layers.owner: Backend durable purpose-scoped facts/review; ML minimized context
layers.input: Permitted evidence, memory provenance/correction, conversation/run state and explicit relationship scopes
layers.output: P0–P3 context, due review, owned resume and independently scoped reports; vectors/cache remain projections
layers.current: Account/device baseline connected; imported Redis session/history and frontend memory previews are not authorized durable VATS memory
layers.exit: SQL ownership/purpose/version controls, inspect/correct/disable, source withdrawal/revocation, no required grounding truncation, due queues and restart/two-device recovery; no imported TTL/purge

layers.name: Data Flywheel & Reviewed Improvement
layers.owner: Backend permitted evidence; ML evaluation and accountable review
layers.input: Minimized versioned outcome/error records, optional feedback and explicitly eligible human-reviewed examples
layers.output: Held-out evaluation sets, qualified outcomes/regressions and human release/rollback decisions; later licensed training candidates
layers.current: Optional account feedback and local metric contracts exist; legacy raw quality/export stays disconnected; full reviewed dataset/evaluation/outcome loop is missing
layers.exit: Launch has permitted outcome evidence and feedback→triage→human review→held-out evaluation→approved change→rollback; raw dialogue/hashed UID is not anonymous training consent
